glossary.definition: (1) "Intrafamily liability exclusion" means any provision included in an automobile insurance policy that excludes liability insurance coverage for the owner or operator of a motor vehicle against a claim for injury or death suffered by a family member of that owner or operator.
glossary.source_title: Section 3937.46 - Applicability of intrafamily liability exclusion against owner or operator of motor vehicle in action for wrongful death.

glossary.definition: (2) "Automobile insurance policy" has the same meaning as in section 3937.30 of the Revised Code.
glossary.source_title: Section 3937.46 - Applicability of intrafamily liability exclusion against owner or operator of motor vehicle in action for wrongful death.

title: Section 3937.46 - Applicability of intrafamily liability exclusion against owner or operator of motor vehicle in action for wrongful death.
